title: research: κ = 0.001729737950064278551242895823 − 10^-52 − 10^-76
body:
This releases the conditional point `κ = 0.001729737950064278551242895823 - 10^-52 - 10^-76`, strictly above the full, unrounded PR #3054 point by approximately `8.95823e-25`. This is a tiny arithmetic rounding refinement of the same T740 six-skip construction. The paid profile, native words, 91 buffers and 663,549 physical families are unchanged.

The adapter applies five declared precision edits and corrects endpoint discovery to bisect the requested grid with the retained fine moment engine. Both original moment engines still require acceptance and rejection of the adjacent 30-digit point; no assertion or cost is removed. The package pins the original source and exact derivation.

Validation completed locally:
- The complete PR #3054 baseline, including fresh native providers, passed. Its outer wall-time allowance was extended without changing scientific checks; `baseline.py` exposes the reproducible allowance.
- The refined complete strict supplier and outer release passed, explicitly reusing the authenticated unchanged native cache. A documented checkpoint reuses successful nomination geometry, then reruns corrected assembly/freeze/independent checks and the complete strict release freshly. `reproduce.py` provides the fresh end-to-end recipe.
- The registered Python 3.12 package check passed: exact gain, both moment engines, 63 strict outer rows, 17 outer rejection controls, and four behavioral test groups under optimized Python.
- Publication bytes match the tested files, and the new package passed a private-data/credential scan. Evidence contains labelled scientific projections and SHA256 commitments; private raw logs and machine metadata are omitted.

The actual controller audit rejects 25 named controls. The unchanged inherited supplier summary says 15; the evidence discloses both rather than rewriting the predecessor receipt. Full replay dependency versions are pinned and their difference from the predecessor environment is documented.

All inherited compiler, physical, precision, caller and analytic hypotheses remain. No selected-frontier update, independent human review, formal proof or hosted CI pass is claimed. Refreshed canonical main and checked competing PRs through #3114; no newer released higher point was found.

Credit Nick Petalas (#3054/#3030/#3024), dcharb78 (#3042), Jeremy Kothe (#3015), Marius-Paul Dumitrean (#2979), dataisfire's retained outer lineage, and the original native/geometry contributors. Apache-2.0; substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Sources, reproduction, limitations and open next questions are in `research/t740-six-skip-precision30/README.md`.
